meta.title: Spiral — Operating System for Decisions
meta.description: Spiral is an integrated system for improving human and organisational decisions. Observe. Understand. Decide. Build.
meta.keywords: decision latency, governance, institutional memory, autonomy, Spiral, SpiralCodes

hero.title: Spiral
hero.subtitle: Operating System for Decisions
hero.lead: We do not sell software. We do not sell courses. We do not sell books. We build an integrated system for improving decisions — human and organisational.
hero.equationCaption: r(θ) = a · e^(bθ) — the logarithmic spiral. Same point, one level higher.

thesis.label: THESIS
thesis.title: People and organisations rarely fail for lack of information.
body: They fail through inertia. We live in the most informed era in history and still postpone what matters. Between the moment a decision is made and the moment it becomes action lies an interval — invisible, unmeasured, expensive.
Spiral exists to make that interval visible. First inside the organisation, where it costs money. Then inside the person, where it costs life.

method.label: METHOD
method.title: Four movements
method.lead: The entire system — corporate and personal — is organised around the same sequence. The order is not decorative: each movement becomes possible only after the one before it.

steps.name: Observe
steps.body: See the ground as it is. No self-deception, no comfortable narrative. Nobody walks steadily across terrain they cannot see.

steps.name: Understand
steps.body: Turn observation into criterion. Raw data decides nothing; understanding sets the standard for what is accepted and what is refused.

steps.name: Decide
steps.body: Choose the vector. Not the ten-year plan with a hundred branches — the next correct step, recorded and auditable.

steps.name: Build
steps.body: Convert the decision into structure. What never becomes work remains opinion. Movement is the only proof.

modulesSection.label: MODULES
modulesSection.title: One system, seven instruments
modulesSection.lead: The modules are not independent products. They are layers of the same system, held together by the same sequence.

modules.name: Spiral Enterprise
modules.lead: Every organisation knows how long it takes to produce. Almost none knows how long it takes to decide. Enterprise measures the interval between a decision and the action that fulfils it.
functions: Decision latency: the time between a decision event and the action realising it, paired by idempotency key.
Operational indicators: median latency, P90 and censorship rate — deterministic, auditable, no inference.
Performance: where the process stalls, who stalls it, and what it costs per cycle.
ROI: the invisible interval turned into a number the board understands.
modules.instrument: A passive instrument. It does not interfere with the process — it records and measures.

modules.name: Spiral Vision
modules.lead: Before deciding, you must see. Vision turns the data an operation already produces into something usable by the people who decide, not only by those who analyse.
functions: Analysis: structured reading of what the operation already produces and nobody reads.
Anticipation: identifying trajectories before the consequence arrives.
Visualisation: panels designed for decisions, not for reports.
Native integration with Ledger and Enterprise.

modules.name: Spiral Ledger
modules.lead: An organisation that cannot remember why it decided starts from zero each cycle. Ledger is the intact record of what was decided, by whom, on what information, and when.
functions: Integrity: an immutable, verifiable, auditable record.
Governance: who decided what, and under which criterion.
Traceability: the full timeline from a decision to its consequence.
Permanence: the memory survives the people who leave.
modules.instrument: In production. The record layer for the whole ecosystem.

modules.name: Spiral Dojo
modules.lead: No instrument repairs a culture. Dojo trains leaders in the one technology that never ages: criterion.
functions: Discipline: repeated practice, not episodic motivation.
Method: the same sequence, applied until it becomes reflex.
Culture: the standard that holds when nobody is watching.
Continuous improvement: the cycle that rises with every turn.
modules.instrument: Delivered in person and remotely. Transmission between people, not by machine.

modules.name: Spiral Vita
modules.lead: A company's decision is born inside a person. Vita is the quietest instrument in the system: a daily pause, one question, one record.
functions: The canonical question: “Did you respect your limit today?”
Low-friction daily reflection — seconds, not sessions.
Awareness: recognising the pattern before it becomes a consequence.
A declared scope: Vita is not therapy. When the signal calls for professional care, it says so plainly.

modules.name: Spiral Elf
modules.lead: The brain freezes in front of the infinite, but it is not afraid of sixty seconds. Elf breaks inertia by reducing a decision to the smallest possible physical action.
functions: Micro-steps: the smallest unit of movement that is still real.
Commitments: what was decided, recorded where it will not disappear.
Protected capital: the financial decision separated from the impulse that contaminates it.
Inertia: measured, named and broken.

modules.name: Spiral Library
modules.lead: An institution exists to transmit orientation through time. The Library is where Spiral's orientation is recorded — before the products, and after them.
functions: Treatises: the founding documents of Spiral's epistemology.
Essays: institutional doctrine and long-horizon thinking.
Novels: the same thesis, told from the inside.
Access: reading, not consumption.

connections.label: CONNECTIONS
connections.title: Nothing here is a standalone product
connections.lead: The modules form two circuits and a bridge between them. Leaving one means entering the other.
connections.note: An organisation's decision is born inside a person. That is why both circuits belong to the same system.

institution.label: INSTITUTION
institution.title: A company captures value. An institution transmits orientation through time.
body: SpiralCodes was designed around that distinction. We do not build for the quarter; we build so that the criterion outlives the person who formed it.

This has practical and uncomfortable consequences: Spiral is slow, refuses the promise of rapid transformation, and measures its own success by the degree of autonomy it installs in the people who use it. A healthy tool does not create dependence — it creates emancipation.
The product dies. The process ages. The model gets copied. Only the criterion crosses oceans.
principles: Act on the long clock, even while living on the short one.
What extracts from those it serves will be abandoned. What returns more than it asks will be kept for generations.
Discipline is not motivation: it is setting correctly the joint nobody will ever see.

contact.label: CONTACT
contact.title: Serious conversations, not forms
contact.lead: If your organisation wants to measure the interval between deciding and acting — or if you want to understand the system before any proposal — write. A person will answer.
